items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Er ist schriftlich beim Amtsgericht Beispielaue einzulegen, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen; die Frist beginnt mit der Zustellung und ist eine Notfrist.
items.computation: Zustellvermerk states delivery by placing the document in the letterbox on 23.11.2026 (Monday) – this is the relevant 'Zustellung' event for the Notfrist under §§ 339, 700 ZPO. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself (23.11.2026) is not counted; the two‑week period starts the next day (24.11.2026). Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period measured in weeks ends with the day of the last week that bears the same name as the day on which the triggering event (Zustellung) occurred, i.e. a Monday. Two weeks after Monday 23.11.2026 is Monday 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is a normal working Monday in Sachsen (no public holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Amtsgericht Beispielaue in writing by this day.

items.title: Pay the titled claim (Hauptforderung, interest and costs)
items.computation: The Vollstreckungsbescheid tituliert a total of EUR 317,50 (Hauptforderung 270,00 + Zinsen 6,30 + Verfahrenskosten 41,20). The letter states enforcement ('Zwangsvollstreckung') can already be pursued by the creditor even before the order becomes final, but it does not name a specific calendar date or period by which payment itself must be made (the underlying debt was already overdue before this order was issued). No countable deadline for the payment itself can therefore be derived from the text; it is effectively due as soon as possible / already overdue, with the real time pressure being the two‑week Einspruch period above.

warnings: No specific payment deadline is stated in the letter for the EUR 317,50 total; only the two-week Einspruch deadline (07.12.2026) is explicit — verify with the court or a lawyer whether paying now or filing Einspruch is the right course of action, since the creditor can already start enforcement.
